_note: What each fixture ride is. `node scripts/verify/record-fixtures.cjs [name…]` generates it once against the dev server's router and writes fixtures/<name>.json. `shapePoints` are pass-through points (afterPlace = index in [start, ...stops]).

ride-0928.description: The rider's own ride-0928.gpx: Antiņciems → Puķes → Rīgas apvedceļš with his four pass-through points.

laurini-ergli.description: Lauriņi → Ērgļi, one way, no stops — the rider's ride-laurini-ergli.gpx request.

grostonas-ergli.description: Grostonas iela 19 → Ērgļi, one way. The ropazi / ogre / batchbad ride.

grostonas-chain.description: Grostonas iela 19 → Sidgunda → Mālpils → Augšmala → Ērgļi, three stops. The chain / mergupe ride.
